audit_result.proof_trace: The Fulu spec mandates returning Electra blob limit (9) when no BlobSchedule entry matches, regardless of epoch. Current code returns epoch-dependent fallback (6 for Deneb-era, 9 for Electra-era), violating spec. Since Fulu is not yet activated (FuluForkEpoch=MaxUint64), no immediate consensus risk, but must be fixed before Fulu fork.
audit_result.attack_scenario: If Fulu activates without updating this logic, nodes querying epochs with no BlobSchedule match would enforce incorrect blob limits for pre-Electra historical epochs, potentially causing consensus splits during sync or validation.

PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-015.text: get_blob_parameters must return Electra defaults when no BLOB_SCHEDULE entry matches.
PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-015.assertion: forall epoch e where no schedule match: get_blob_parameters(e)==BlobParameters(ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH, MAX_BLOBS_ELECTRA)

audit_result.proof_trace: When requests fall outside data_column_serve_range, validateDataColumnsByRange returns nil (L198-200), causing the handler to return nil (L72-74) which sends a success response with zero sidecars instead of responseCodeResourceUnavailable as required by the assertion.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker sends DataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest with startSlot before minValidSlot or after currentSlot. Server responds with success (code 0x00) and empty data instead of ResourceUnavailable (code 0x03), violating P2P spec expectations.

PROP-6a4369e9-pre-008.text: data_column_sidecars_by_range must reject requests outside data_column_serve_range.
PROP-6a4369e9-pre-008.assertion: forall req: req.range outside serve_range => response == ResourceUnavailable

audit_result.proof_trace: ComputeCells returns len(cells) from external library without validating len(cells) == 128. Code then accesses cells[0..127] in loop without bounds check. Proof fails because contract depends on unverified assumption that c-kzg-4844 library always returns exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB cells.
audit_result.attack_scenario: If external library has bug or version mismatch causing it to return fewer than 128 cells, code panics at cells[columnIndex] access (out-of-bounds), causing validator DoS.

PROP-57888860-post-003.text: compute_cells must produce exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB cells from a valid blob.

audit_result.proof_trace: ComputeForkDigest only uses fork_version and genesis_validators_root (lines 304-310), ignoring blob parameters entirely. For Fulu (EIP-7892), fork digests must incorporate blob params via XOR with hash(epoch||max_blobs). The network schedule correctly implements this (config.go:576-590), but ComputeForkDigest bypasses it. When bootnode or other code paths call ComputeForkDigest directly for Fulu, networks with same fork_version but different blob params produce identical digests, breaking network isolation.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker configures bootnode for Fulu fork with different MaxBlobsPerBlock than the legitimate network but same ForkVersion. ComputeForkDigest (bootnode.go:221) produces identical fork digest. Victim nodes connect to attacker's network thinking it's the same chain, leading to consensus failures, incompatible block processing, and potential chain split.

PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-027.text: Fork digest must differ when blob parameters change, even if fork version is unchanged (EIP-7892).

audit_result.proof_trace: Spec requires get_checkpoint_block(store, parent_root, finalized_epoch) == finalized_root to verify ancestry. Implementation only checks fc.HasNode(parentRoot) which verifies parent exists in fork choice store but does NOT verify it descends from finalized checkpoint. An attacker can send sidecars on finalized-conflicting forks that exist in fork choice.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker broadcasts data column sidecar with parent_root on a non-finalized fork (e.g., during reorg window). If parent exists in fork choice but conflicts with finalized checkpoint ancestry, gossip accepts it, causing honest nodes to propagate invalid sidecars and potentially reconstruct invalid blocks.

PROP-6a4369e9-pre-006.text: Gossip validation must reject sidecar if finalized checkpoint is not an ancestor of block.
